## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      2 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 24 jul 2026 - 12 ago 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Jaroslav Holaň_, 24 jul 2026, 1/5: "Unfortunately, the app only offers several dark themes. This makes it practically unusable for me because I need a light theme. A light interface is easier for me to read during the day, especially outdoors or in a well-lit room. Dark themes are less comfortable for my eyes, make navigation more difficult, and cause fatigue during longer use. I would therefore appreciate a proper light theme, ideally with the option to follow the phone’s system settings automatically."
            2. _Parth Magar_, 12 ago 2026, 4/5: "hey app is just awesome but there is bug i am using widgets of habit the streak shown in app is different from the widgets streak keep both same..."
